name: symbolic-math-bridge-windows
description: Manifest for the Windows build of the symbolic_math_bridge plugin.
_note_baseline: no builtin-baseline pin — the windows-latest runner's bundled vcpkg is older than the ref Android uses; adding a pin caused 'failed to git show versions/baseline.json'. Re-add when we want strict reproducibility (and pair it with a `git -C C:\vcpkg fetch origin master` step in the workflow).
